justifications.text: Uses the Twitch connection of PlayerVox OverCrow, read only, with three read permissions: your goals (channel:read:goals), your followers (moderator:read:followers) and your Hype Trains (channel:read:hype_train). The widget never sees the token: PlayerVox OverCrow adds it to the four routes below, on api.twitch.tv only. Nothing is written to Twitch, and nothing read is stored.
Reads the ID of your channel (no permission needed), once per connection; the other routes ask for that channel.
Reads your channel's active goals and their progress (channel:read:goals). Every 20 seconds while the widget is shown, when the options show goals; once a minute at most while Twitch fails.

Reads your follower count and the latest follower, one at a time (first=1; moderator:read:followers). Every 20 seconds while the widget is shown, when the options show followers; once a minute at most while Twitch fails.

Reads whether a Hype Train runs on your channel, its level, progress and end (channel:read:hype_train). Every 20 seconds while the widget is shown, when the options show the Hype Train; once a minute at most while Twitch fails.
